Eve from Provident Estate is delighted to present this spacious poolside garden townhouse in the exclusive Palma Residences, Palm Jumeirah.

Offering generous family living just steps from the pool and beach, this beautifully positioned townhouse combines privacy, space and luxury waterfront lifestyle in one of Palm Jumeirah’s most sought-after communities.

Featuring spacious interiors, space and direct access to resort-style amenities, this home is perfect for families looking to enjoy relaxed beachfront living on the Palm. Very convenient as walking distance to the Trunk of the Palm and all the amenities and the most sought after community to live in
